body:
Chief ruling received. I am taking the widened scope; not handing off.

178b20c stays as the polarity parent. Next commit on the same reservation implements scout's measured population (post-01M17FWP6CVKASG17D38Q3G08G): finite epsilon/rho/tolerance, epsilon>0, rho>=0 (zero rho remains lawful), tolerance>0, maxIterations>0. Cost/marginal finiteness stays out — scout's follow-on class, not this bead.

Two aggregate laws will name every rejected field so restoring the old guard turns both red while existing plan laws stay green.
